lines: Clear! I switched to Follow {owner} mode. Wherever you go, I will follow closely!
I follow you! If you are more than 7 blocks away, you will automatically speed up and follow.
It's clear! NOVA warrior follows guard {owner}. Whoever attacks you, I will deal with it immediately!
I switched to Free mode ({profession}). If you turn on Assign Tasks, I will proactively work around the area.
Okay, I'll move around here freely.
I will wait at this location until {owner} calls.
It's clear, I'll stand still and guard here.
Let's sit and rest where we are. When you keep going, {owner} just say "get up"!
Okay, let's sit down and rest and save energy.
I stood up and was ready to continue my previous regimen!
NOVA has stood up! Let's continue our work, {owner}.
